named-native-query.name: EsqAccessProfileJpa.access
named-native-query.query: SELECT usr_pk ,usr_et_pk ,usr_name ,ep_path AS usr_path ,au_login_id ,au_email ,COALESCE(au_force_change_flg, 'N') AS au_force_change_flg ,au_tfa_method ,au_connect_flg FROM esq_user JOIN esq_auth ON au_usr_pk = usr_pk JOIN esq_entity_path ON ep_pk = usr_pk WHERE usr_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint) AND ep_path LIKE (:rootPath || '%')

named-native-query.name: EsqAccessProfileJpa.roles
named-native-query.query: SELECT role_pk ,role_name ,role_pt_pk FROM esq_usr_role JOIN esq_role ON role_pk = ur_role_pk WHERE ur_usr_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqAccessProfileJpa.rolesAll
named-native-query.query: SELECT role_pk ,role_name ,role_pt_pk FROM esq_role JOIN esq_role_et ON rt_role_pk = role_pk JOIN esq_user ON usr_et_pk = rt_et_pk WHERE usr_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqAccessProfileJpa.permissions
named-native-query.query: SELECT prm_pk ,pt_name ,COALESCE(prm_et_pk, 0) AS prm_et_pk ,prm_name ,rp_allowed_flgs FROM esq_usr_role JOIN esq_role_prm ON rp_role_pk = ur_role_pk JOIN esq_permission ON prm_pk = rp_prm_pk JOIN esq_permission_type ON pt_pk = prm_pt_pk WHERE ur_usr_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqAccessProfileJpa.accessForUpdate
named-native-query.query: SELECT usr_pk ,usr_et_pk ,usr_name ,ep_path AS usr_path ,au_login_id ,au_email ,COALESCE(au_force_change_flg, 'N') AS au_force_change_flg ,au_tfa_method ,au_connect_flg FROM esq_user JOIN esq_auth ON au_usr_pk = usr_pk JOIN esq_entity_path ON ep_pk = usr_pk WHERE usr_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint) AND ep_path LIKE (:rootPath || '%') FOR UPDATE OF esq_user

named-native-query.name: EsqAccessProfileJpa.deleteUserRole
named-native-query.query: DELETE FROM esq_usr_role WHERE ur_usr_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint) AND ur_role_pk = CAST(:roleId AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqAccessProfileJpa.insertUserRole
named-native-query.query: INSERT INTO esq_usr_role (ur_usr_pk, ur_role_pk) VALUES (CAST(:id AS bigint), CAST(:roleId AS bigint))

named-native-query.name: EsqAccessProfileJpa.confirmPendingFlags
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_auth SET au_force_change_flg = COALESCE(CAST(:pwdChangeForced AS varchar), au_force_change_flg) ,au_tfa_method = COALESCE(CAST(:tfaMethod AS varchar), au_tfa_method) WHERE au_usr_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqAccessProfileJpa.updateAccess
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_auth SET au_email = :email ,au_login_id = :loginId ,au_force_change_flg = :pwdChangeForced ,au_tfa_method = :tfaMethod ,au_connect_flg = :connectFlg ,au_crl_id = :correlationId ,au_req_id = :requestId ,au_uid = :uid WHERE au_usr_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint)
